title: Book robustness taxonomy
caption: The book's full subtype decomposition: each pillar descends onto a defense wall where it enters the pipeline. Our silent-failure sketch keeps the three pillars but organizes them by evidence family instead.
alt: Three pillar columns with failure chips descending onto defense walls over a pipeline rail

title: Book shift-type geometry
caption: The book's three-panel picture of covariate shift, label shift and concept drift as changes in input region, label prior and mapping. Our packet carries the what-stays-fixed rule in prose.
alt: Three panels showing inputs migrating, label priors skewing and the mapping itself changing

title: Book bit-flip corruption path
caption: The book's figure tracing one flipped FP32 exponent bit from memory through a hidden unit to the output logits. Our packet keeps the 2^128 scaling arithmetic and the finite-outlier point in prose.
alt: Network diagram tracing a corrupted weight through a hidden unit to output logits

title: Book FGSM corner geometry
caption: The book's illustration of the sign-gradient step carrying the input to a corner of the budget cube across the decision boundary. Our packet states the same first-order alignment argument in the FGSM section.
alt: Perturbation moving an input to a cube corner across a decision boundary

title: Book selective-prediction routing
caption: The book's routing diagram for answer, stronger model or reviewer, and abstain. Our risk-coverage sketch focuses on the curve and the fallback-load arithmetic instead.
alt: Routing diagram splitting requests across answer, fallback and abstain paths

title: Book paired pipeline replay
caption: The book's diagram of replaying golden inputs through version-pinned pipelines and comparing tensors stage by stage. Our fault-masquerade sketch compresses the same diagnosis into its replay signal.
alt: Two pipeline versions replaying the same inputs with per-stage tensor comparison

title: Book poisoning interception layers
caption: The book's figure of the interception layer examining contributed records before training. Our packet carries the four ordered layers as a numbered list in the poisoning section.
alt: Defense layers intercepting poisoned records along the data path

title: Book autoencoder ingestion gate
caption: The book's bottleneck autoencoder accepting low-reconstruction-error records and quarantining outliers. Our packet notes the blind spot: autoencoders can reconstruct unfamiliar inputs well or learn the attack pattern from a contaminated reference.
alt: Autoencoder compressing inputs through a bottleneck and filtering by reconstruction error

title: Book PSI timeline
caption: The book's PSI-over-weeks plot with warning and major-shift bands and the week-41 reference re-approval. Our packet explains in prose why the lower PSI after week 41 does not establish improved predictions.
alt: Weekly PSI line crossing warning and critical bands then dropping after reference re-approval

title: Book clean-versus-robust trade-off
caption: The book's comparison of clean and robust decision boundaries. Our packet keeps the robustness-margin argument in prose: each compression technique can shrink the margin even when clean accuracy holds.
alt: Comparison of clean and robust classification decision boundaries
